rounds_note: Prices are each round's conversion price: what it paid for each share of common stock it becomes.
what: It develops medicines that remove disease-causing immune cells, to treat immune-system diseases and cancer.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $319.9 million. It plans about $220.0 million for its lead drug's trial in a serious immune condition and for approval filing and launch preparation, $25.0 million for blood cancer trials, $50.0 million for a second drug, and the rest for research and general costs.
risks: Electra is young, has no approved products and has never earned revenue, so its chances of success are hard to judge.
It has lost money every period, expects bigger losses ahead, and may never make a profit.
Even with this offering, it will need much more money, and may have to cut or delay its programs if it cannot raise it.
